Very expensive drinks and no prices on the menus
May 2025 • Friends
Went here with some friends late at 12pm, Googled to see if it was open beforehand, got there and bouncer said they were closed. I said still open on Google for another 2 hrs, I told him this, he sent a text message to someone and then let us in. 
The bar had about 20 people in it. We ordered 2 mojitos and 3 beers (they only had Corona) this came to 2,200,000 which is over £60 for 5 drinks!!! There weren’t any prices in the drinks menu just pictures of the drinks, so once ordered had to pay what they said. 
I think this place is dodgy and wouldn’t recommend.

Best Cocktails in Hanoi
Aug 2022
I walked past this place with my girlfriend, and decided to chance it and go inside. IT WAS AMAZING. I went to maybe 8 different cocktail bars in Hanoi, and this place blew them out of the water. The drinks were great, the staff was friendly, the music was GOOD. Everything about this place was amazing. Their manager was so welcoming to me and my girlfriend and made our night so memorable. Cash is preferred there, so please take note. They also take other forms of payment.

I'll go back whenever I visit Hanoi again.
